en-e1-l1.title: Alfabetu no lian dahuluk
en-e1-l1.concept: Liafuan fasil atu hanoin bainhira ó hatene ninia lian dahuluk no letra dahuluk. Lee ho lian maka'as no tuir lian sira.
en-e1-l1.example: ball → B, cat → C, dog → D

en-e1-l2.title: Hato'o kumprimentu
en-e1-l2.concept: Bainhira hasoru malu, dehan **Hello**. Bainhira sai, dehan **Goodbye**. Dehan ó-nia naran ho **My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Númeru no kór
en-e1-l3.concept: Aprende liafuan númeru hanesan one, two, three... no liafuan kór hanesan red, blue, yellow...

en-e1-l4.title: Família
en-e1-l4.concept: mother (inan), father (aman), grandmother (avó feto), baby (bebé): liafuan sira-ne'e atu bolu ema iha família.

en-e1-l5.title: Liafuan iha sala-aula
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Koko dehan sasán iha sala-aula ho lia-inglés.

en-e2-l1.title: Naran animál no sasán
en-e2-l1.concept: Liafuan ne'ebé hatudu naran, hanesan rabbit (koelu), bird (manu) no fish (ikan), naran **substantivu**.

en-e2-l2.title: Liafuan ba asaun
en-e2-l2.concept: Liafuan ne'ebé hatudu movimentu, hanesan jump (salta), run (halai) no eat (han), naran **verbu**.

en-e2-l3.title: I like / I have
en-e2-l3.concept: **I like ...** katak 'ha'u gosta ...', no **I have ...** katak 'ha'u iha ...'.
en-e2-l3.example: I like dogs. I have a cat.

en-e2-l4.title: Halo fraze badak
en-e2-l4.concept: Hafoin I, uza **am**. Hafoin You, uza **are**. Fraze tuir orden 'sé → oinsá / halo saida'.
en-e2-l4.example: I am a student. You are kind.

en-e2-l5.title: Lee testu badak
en-e2-l5.concept: Bainhira lee, uluk buka liafuan husi pergunta iha testu laran.
en-e2-l5.example: Mina has a cat. → busa ida

en-e3-l1.title: Harii fraze
en-e3-l1.concept: Fraze tuir orden 'sé → halo → saida'. Hafoin He, She ka ema nia naran, aumenta **-s** ba verbu.

en-e3-l2.title: Pronome
en-e3-l2.concept: Iha naran nia fatin, ó bele uza **He** (nia, mane), **She** (nia, feto), **It** (nia, sasán), **They** (sira), **We** (ita).
en-e3-l2.example: Tom is tall. He is tall.

en-e3-l3.title: Prezente no pasadu
en-e3-l3.concept: Ba buat ne'ebé akontese agora ka repete, uza **prezente**. Ba buat ne'ebé akontese tiha ona, uza **pasadu**: aumenta **-ed** iha verbu nia rohan.

en-e3-l4.title: Rutina loron-loron
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Koko konta ó-nia rutina loron-loron ho lia-inglés.

en-e3-l5.title: Komprende testu
en-e3-l5.concept: Lee testu no buka sé mak halo saida, no bainhira.

en-e4-l1.title: Prezente, pasadu no futuru
en-e4-l1.concept: Ba agora ka toman, uza **prezente**. Ba pasadu, aumenta **-ed**. Ba buat ne'ebé ó sei halo, uza **will + verbu forma báziku**.
en-e4-l1.example: I will visit my aunt tomorrow.

en-e4-l2.title: Pergunta no fraze negativa
en-e4-l2.concept: Hahú pergunta ho **Do/Does**. Atu dehan lae, uza **don't/doesn't**.
en-e4-l2.example: Do you like pizza? I don't like onions.

en-e4-l3.title: Liafuan ba forma no sentimentu
en-e4-l3.concept: big (boot), small (ki'ik), hot (manas), cold (malirin): liafuan sira-ne'e deskreve oinsá buat ida haree ka sente.

en-e4-l4.title: Liafuan ba fatin
en-e4-l4.concept: Uza **on** (iha leten), **in** (iha laran), **under** (iha okos), **behind** (iha kotuk) atu dehan sasán iha ne'ebé.
en-e4-l4.example: The book is on the desk.

en-e4-l5.title: Lee testu badak
en-e4-l5.concept: Buka iha testu sé mak halo saida no iha ne'ebé, depois responde.

en-e5-l1.title: Artigu, plurál no There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Uza **an** antes lian vogál no **a** antes lian konsoante. Ba buat ida, uza **There is**. Ba buat barak, uza **There are**.
en-e5-l1.example: an apple, two boxes, There are three books.

en-e5-l2.title: Liafuan atu kompara
en-e5-l2.concept: Atu kompara buat rua, uza **-er + than**. Ba 'liu hotu', uza **the -est**. Ba liafuan naruk, uza **more**.

en-e5-l3.title: Ko'alia kona-ba futuru
en-e5-l3.concept: Ba buat ne'ebé ó sei halo, uza **will + verbu forma báziku** ka **be going to + verbu forma báziku**.
en-e5-l3.example: I am going to visit Jeju.

en-e5-l4.title: Hakerek fali fraze
en-e5-l4.concept: Ba fraze negativa, uza **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**. Ba pergunta, tau **Are / Do / Does** iha fraze nia hahú.
en-e5-l4.example: I am happy. → I am not happy.

en-e5-l5.title: Komprende testu
en-e5-l5.concept: Testu naruk sai fasil se ó buka sé, iha ne'ebé, bainhira no saida, hanesan ó risku sira iha okos.

en-e6-l1.title: Revee tempu verbál hotu
en-e6-l1.concept: Ba buat ne'ebé akontese agora, uza **be + -ing**. Ba pasadu, uza **tempu pasadu**. Ba futuru, uza **will / be going to**.

en-e6-l2.title: can, must, should, may
en-e6-l2.concept: **can** (bele), **must** (tenke), **should** (di'ak atu), **may** (hetan lisensa atu): hafoin sira mai verbu forma báziku.

en-e6-l3.title: Aumenta vokabuláriu
en-e6-l3.concept: Aprende hamutuk liafuan ho signifikadu besik malu no liafuan kontráriu, no ó-nia vokabuláriu sei sai dala rua.

en-e6-l4.title: Liafuan atu liga
en-e6-l4.example: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

en-e6-l5.title: Lee parágrafu
en-e6-l5.concept: Lee testu ho fraze barak no buka sé mak halo buat ruma, bainhira no tanba saida, depois responde.
en-e6-l5.example: Jina was tired because they walked a lot.

en-h1-l1.title: Tempu perfeitu no perfeitu kontínuu
en-h1-l1.concept: had + p.p. ba buat ne'ebé akontese antes eventu pasadu seluk; have been -ing ba asaun ne'ebé kontinua to'o agora.
en-h1-l1.example: I have been waiting for an hour.

en-h1-l2.title: Advérbiu relativu no orasaun substantiva
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why mak relativu ne'ebé servisu hanesan advérbiu; whether / that hahú orasaun substantiva.
en-h1-l2.example: This is the town where I was born.

en-h1-l3.title: Orasaun partisípiu
en-h1-l3.concept: Hasai konjunsaun no sujeitu, no troka verbu ba -ing. Sujeitu tenke hanesan iha parte rua.

en-h1-l4.title: Liafuan liga no fluxu testu nian
en-h1-l4.concept: Haketak kauza–efeitu (so, therefore), kontraste (however), ezemplu (for example) no aumentu (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Ideia prinsipál no prenxe espasu mamuk
en-h1-l5.concept: Ideia prinsipál dala barak iha hafoin However, ne'ebé fila hanoin komún, no iha fraze ikus. Prenxe espasu mamuk tuir fluxu problema → solusaun → rezultadu.

en-h2-l1.title: Inversaun no énfaze
en-h2-l1.concept: Bainhira Never/Hardly/Only then mai uluk, orden sai verbu auxiliár + sujeitu. Uza It is ~ that atu fó énfaze.
en-h2-l1.example: Never have I seen such a view.

en-h2-l2.title: Subjuntivu (kondisaun la reál)
en-h2-l2.concept: Iha I wish / as if / If, uza pasadu ba kontráriu husi prezente, no had p.p. ba kontráriu husi pasadu.
en-h2-l2.example: I wish I had studied harder.

en-h2-l3.title: Relativu kompostu no orasaun konsesiva
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever no however + adjetivu signifika 'saida de'it / sé de'it / ida ne'ebé de'it / maske oinsá ...'.
en-h2-l3.example: However hard it is, I will try.

en-h2-l4.title: Vokabuláriu iha kontestu
en-h2-l4.concept: Buka hatene signifikadu liafuan foun husi sinál kontraste, ezemplu no kauza, no husi ninia prefiksu.

en-h2-l5.title: Fluxu lójiku testu nian
en-h2-l5.concept: Tuir testu nia fluxu ho liafuan ne'ebé hatudu ba buat ruma no liafuan liga. Halibur detalle sira atu to'o konkluzaun.
en-h2-l5.example: In this way = ho dalan ne'e

en-h3-l1.title: Estrutura paralela no konkordánsia
en-h3-l1.concept: Parte sira ne'ebé liga ho and/but/or iha forma hanesan. Verbu tuir sujeitu prinsipál.

en-h3-l2.title: Ambiente, tonu no objetivu
en-h3-l2.concept: Hatene ambiente husi liafuan deskritivu no emosionál. Hatene objetivu se testu husu, fó informasaun ka konvense.
en-h3-l2.example: Please store enough water. → avizu (fó informasaun)

en-h3-l3.title: Orden fraze no insersaun
en-h3-l3.concept: Uza liafuan liga, liafuan hatudu no orden tempu hanesan sinál atu tau fraze sira iha orden no buka fatin ba fraze ne'ebé fó.

en-h3-l4.title: Kolokasaun no espresaun idiomátika
en-h3-l4.concept: Aprende liafuan ne'ebé la'o hamutuk, hanesan make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain, no buka hatene signifikadu espresaun idiomátika husi situasaun.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = problema ikus ne'ebé halo ita lakon pasiénsia

en-h3-l5.title: Kompleta rezumu
en-h3-l5.concept: Buka testu nia ideia xave no espresaun kontraste, no hamenus sira ba fraze ida de'it.
en-h3-l5.example: cost more ↔ save money in the long run

en-l1.title: Aprende liafuan loron-loron
en-l1.concept: Liafuan ne'ebé ita uza beibeik sei hela kleur iha memória se ó aprende hamutuk **lian + signifikadu + hakerek**. Hili butaun altifalante atu rona pronúnsia.
en-l1.example: library = biblioteka / desk = meza / milk = susubeen

en-l2.title: Verbu be: am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Verbu be muda forma tuir sujeitu. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.
en-l2.example: I am a student. She is my friend. They are in the classroom.

en-l3.title: Prezente husi verbu komún
en-l3.concept: Se sujeitu mak **he / she / it (tersera pesoa singulár)**, aumenta **-s / -es** ba verbu. Liafuan ne'ebé remata ho -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o simu -es; ba konsoante + y, troka y ba i no aumenta -es!
en-l3.example: go → goes / watch → watches / study → studies

en-l4.title: Plurál no harii fraze
en-l4.concept: Se substantivu iha rua ka liu, baibain aumenta **-s**; se remata ho -x, aumenta **-es**; plurál irregulár tenke hatene ho kabeen. Fraze tuir orden **sujeitu → verbu → seluk**.
en-l4.example: book → books / box → boxes / child → children

en-m2-l1.title: Present perfect (prezente perfeitu)
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + partisípiu pasadu. Hatudu esperiénsia, buat ne'ebé remata ona ka kontinua; haketak since (momentu ida) no for (durasaun).
en-m2-l1.example: I have lived here for five years.

en-m2-l2.title: Voz pasiva
en-m2-l2.concept: Uza be + partisípiu pasadu atu dehan katak buat ruma hetan asaun. Aumenta sé mak halo ho by.
en-m2-l2.example: The room is cleaned by Mina.

en-m2-l3.title: Infinitivu ho to no jerúndiu
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + infinitivu ho to; enjoy, finish, avoid + jerúndiu. stop + to V hatudu objetivu, no stop + V-ing katak para halo asaun ida.
en-m2-l3.example: I want to buy a bike. She enjoys singing.

en-m2-l4.title: Komparativu no superlativu
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est no more/most. Uza than ho komparativu no the ho superlativu. good → better → best mak irregulár.

en-m2-l5.title: Leitura: tópiku no detalle
en-m2-l5.concept: Lee uluk pergunta, depois buka fraze ne'ebé fó sinál. Títulu no ideia prinsipál kobre testu tomak.

en-m3-l1.title: Pronome relativu
en-m3-l1.concept: Liga fraze rua sai ida ho who (ema), which (sasán), that (rua hotu) no whose (na'in).
en-m3-l1.example: I have a friend who lives in Canada.

en-m3-l2.title: Fraze kondisionál no ipótese la reál
en-m3-l2.concept: If + prezente, will + V (buat ne'ebé bele akontese). If + pasadu, would + V (imajina buat ne'ebé la los agora).
en-m3-l2.example: If I were rich, I would travel.

en-m3-l3.title: Pergunta indireta
en-m3-l3.concept: Uza orden liafuan-pergunta + sujeitu + verbu. Labele uza do/does/did.
en-m3-l3.example: Do you know where he lives?

en-m3-l4.title: Partisípiu
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing mak ativu ka la'o hela; -ed mak pasivu ka remata ona. Ba sentimentu, uza -ing ba buat ne'ebé halo ita sente, no -ed ba ema ne'ebé sente.
en-m3-l4.example: an exciting game / I am excited

en-m3-l5.title: Leitura: inferénsia no objetivu testu nian
en-m3-l5.concept: Kombina sinál sira atu halo inferénsia. Deside testu nia objetivu husi ninia pedidu no opiniaun.
en-m3-l5.example: Could you tell me ...? → pergunta (husu informasaun)

en-h3e-l1.title: Hili liafuan ne'ebé loos tuir situasaun
en-h3e-l1.concept: Iha pergunta konversa nian, tenke haree la'ós de'it gramátika loos, maibé mós se jeitu ko'alia iha situasaun ne'e natural no ho respeitu. Sujestaun, tama iha ema nia fali, hatán ba kumprimentu, espresaun idiomátika no ko'alia ho kuidadu barak mak mosu.
en-h3e-l1.example: Could you pass me the salt, please? (Bele fó mai hau masin, favór ida?) / I'm all ears. (Hau rona ho di'ak.)

en-h3e-l2.title: Espresaun no kolokasaun iha serbisu
en-h3e-l2.concept: Iha Inglés serbisu nian, ida-ne'ebé importante mak espresaun idiomátika (touch base), abreviatura (ASAP no seluk) no ligasaun entre verbu no preposisaun (kolokasaun). Labele tradús liafuan ida-idak; hanoin nu'udar grupu ne'ebé uza iha situasaun serbisu.
en-h3e-l2.example: Let's circle back on this later. (Ita koalia fali kona-ba ne'e iha tempu seluk.) / Please keep me in the loop. (Favór informa hau kontinua kona-ba progresu.)

en-h3e-l3.title: Lee informasaun ho hanoin krítiku
en-h3e-l3.concept: Iha Inglés média nian, importante atu hatene hakbesik loos entre faktu no opiniaun, no avalia se razaun ne'ebé uza iha argumentu loos ka lae. Termu hanesan deskrisaun imajen (alt text, caption) no ferramenta edisaun mós tenke hanoin ho sira-nia objetivu.

en-h3e-l4.title: Vokabulariu kultura nian no atitude ne'ebé loke
en-h3e-l4.concept: Iha tema kultura mundu nian, aprende liafuan prinsipál hanesan culture, diversity, stereotype, no espresaun atu komprende kultura seluk la julga. Hatene hasai liafuan ne'ebé hatudu hanesan husi pistas kontestu.
en-h3e-l4.example: Greetings differ across cultures, and I'm curious about them. (Kumprimentu diferente iha kultura ida-idak, no hau hakarak hatene.)

en-h3e-l5.title: Lee obra ho termu literáriu
en-h3e-l5.concept: Iha pergunta literatura nian, ida-ne'ebé importante mak hatene definisaun termu no aplika ba sena iha istória. Hatene hasai diferensa entre foreshadowing, símbolu, pontu de vista, tema no papél personajen.
en-h3e-l5.example: The hero (protagonist) wants to save his village. (Eroi (protagonist) hakarak salva nia suku.) / A storm often suggests trouble. (Rai-bailoro dala barak hatudu problema.)

en-h3e-l6.title: Hatene argumentu no sala lójika
en-h3e-l6.concept: Iha debate presiza kapasidade atu hasai diferensa entre termu (motion, rebuttal no seluk), tipu evidénsia no sala lójika. Bainhira avalia argumentu, husu uluk: ‘Saida mak nia baze?’
en-h3e-l6.example: I disagree because the data shows otherwise. (Hau la konkorda tanba dadus hatudu seluk.) / My opponent claims... but... (Hau-nia oponente sustenta katak... maibé...)

en-h3e-l7.title: Hakerek ho loos no tuir objetivu
en-h3e-l7.concept: Iha hakerek, hili forma ne'ebé tuir objetivu no leitór, no verifika elementu fraze (sujeitu no verbu) no lójika liafuan ligasaun. Iha testu espesífiku hanesan CV, asaun no númeru di'ak liu duke liafuan la klaru.
en-h3e-l7.example: The weather was bad; however, we enjoyed the trip. (Tempu aat, maibé ami gosta viajen ne'e.)

en-e3-abc1.title: Letra boot no letra ki'ik
en-e3-abc1.concept: Alfabetu iha **letra boot** no **letra ki'ik**. Par barak hatudu la hanesan, tan ne'e aprende par ida-idak. Tau matan liu ba letra sira ne'ebé hatudu hanesan, hanesan b, d, p no q.

en-e3-snd1.title: Lian no ortografia
en-e3-snd1.concept: Lian dahuluk husi liafuan ida liga ba nia letra dahuluk. Buka liafuan sira ne'ebé hahú ho lian hanesan atu aprende oinsá lian no ortografia liga malu. Dala ruma letra rua, hanesan ph, halo lian f.

en-e6-seq1.title: Buka orden husi akontesimentu sira
en-e6-seq1.concept: Liafuan sira ne'ebé hatudu orden, hanesan **First**, **Then / Next**, **After that** no **Finally**, hatete ba ita orden saida mak akontese.
en-e6-seq1.example: First, I wake up. Then I eat breakfast. Finally, I go to school.

en-e6-pun1.title: Letra boot no sinál pontuasaun

hints: Rezume kondisaun ne'ebé presiza. Sujere koresaun maibé labele hamos testu orijinál.
Verifika se hili ida-idak relasiona ho edisaun dokumentu no, se relasiona, nia hatudu mudansa tanba konserva orijinál.

e-h3e-media-d1.explanation: Echo chamber mak grupu ne'ebé rona de'it opiniaun hanesan ho nia rasik, ne'ebé hametin hanoin. Sala chat ne'ebé repete mensajen dala rua repete de'it lian ka testu, la relasiona ho tendénsia opiniaun.
hints: Echo chamber la'ós kuartu loloos, maibé espresaun figuradu. Hanoin lian ne'ebé ressoa iha online hanesan saida.
Hanoin saida mak fila fali kontinua hanesan eko, no hasai diferensa entre hili ne'ebé koalia kona-ba lian rasik ho hili ne'ebé koalia kona-ba ema nia hanoin.

e-h3e-world-1.explanation: Resposta loos mak lian ne'ebé ema ho lian-inan diferente uza. Papél Inglés iha komunikasaun internasionál mak ezemplu. Lian família ida de'it labele sai lian komún.
hints: Ba liafuan estranjeiru foun, hanoin kontestu uza. Hanoin oinsá ema komunika iha enkontru internasionál ka komérsiu.
Iha hili ida-idak, kompara se ema ida mak uza lian ne'e no sira-nia relasaun saida.

e-h3e-world-2.explanation: Resposta loos mak stereotype. Nia signifika fiar simplista liu kona-ba grupu tomak. dialect signifika lian rejionál, la'ós fiar kona-ba ema.
hints: Ba pergunta definisaun, hili liafuan xave. oversimplified no whole group mak xave.
Klasifika uluk se liafuan hili ida-idak hatudu hanoin kona-ba grupu, jeitu koalia, eventu ka família.

e-h3e-world-3.explanation: Resposta loos mak diversity. Cultural diversity mak diversidade kultura. Division signifika ‘fahe, divizaun’, ne'ebé kontráriu ho esplikasaun ‘hela hamutuk’.
hints: Ba liafuan ho hakerek hanesan, kompara signifikadu ho pista husi esplikasaun depois fatin mamuk.
Kompara esplikasaun ‘ema husi background diferente hela hamutuk’ ho signifikadu naran ne'ebé tuir natural cultural.

e-h3e-world-4.explanation: Resposta loos mak Their customs are different from ours, and I would like to learn why. Ne'e atitude ne'ebé rekoñese diferensa no hakarak aprende. Liafuan hanesan strange and backward hatún kultura seluk.
hints: Ba pergunta sensibilidade kultura, haree se julga kultura seluk ka hakarak komprende.
Verifika se iha liafuan hanesan all, wrong, backward ne'ebé jeneraliza ka fahe ne'ebé aas ka kraik.

e-h3e-world-5.explanation: Resposta loos mak authentic. Nia signifika ‘loloos, fiar’. artificial signifika ema halo, falsu, entaun kontráriu.
hints: Troka liafuan xave husi definisaun genuine ba liafuan fasil.
Hanoin saida mak kontráriu ba ‘not copied’, no hasai uluk hili ho signifikadu kontráriu.

e-h3e-world-d1.explanation: Indigenous signifika ne'ebé hela iha rejiaun husi bainhira, ne'ebé husi rai ne'e rasik. Foreign signifika mai husi nasaun seluk, entaun kontráriu.
hints: Lee definisaun no foti signifikadu xave, depois kompara ho signifikadu liafuan ida-idak.
Konsentra ba “the first people who lived in a region”. Husi liafuan kona-ba moda, época ka orijen, buka ida ne'ebé tuir signifikadu ne'e.

e-h3e-lit-1.explanation: Resposta loos mak foreshadowing (prenúnsiu). Ne'e rekursu ne'ebé sujere uluk saida mak sei mosu. flashback fila ba sena pasadu, entaun la sujere saida mak sei mosu.
hints: Termu literatura nian, hanoin definisaun no aplika ba dalan eventu. Iha tempu saida husi istória rekursu ne'e hala'o?
Haree ordem entre bainhira dehan ponte fraku no bainhira ponte monu.

e-h3e-lit-2.explanation: Resposta loos mak peace. Ruma-mutin mak símbolu tradisionál paz iha literatura. Danger la tuir sena ne'ebé funu remata ona.
hints: Iha poema, animál ka objetu bele sai símbolu. Liga ho atmosfera sena ne'ebé nia mosu.
Hanoin kondisaun saida mak ema hakarak depois funu, no buka liafuan ba kondisaun ne'e.

e-h3e-lit-3.explanation: Resposta loos mak pontu de vista omniscient (hatene hotu). Tanba narrador hatene hanoin personajen barak. Pontu de vista limited fó de'it hanoin personajen ida, entaun la tuir ezemplu ne'ebé hatudu laran ema rua.
hints: Ba pergunta pontu de vista, haree se mak koalia no narrador hatene laran ema hira.
Verifika se ezemplu hatudu laran Anna no Tom hotu, no hili pontu de vista ne'ebé tuir abranjénsia ne'e.

e-h3e-lit-4.explanation: Resposta loos mak Kindness often comes back to those who give it. Nia dehan kauza-efeitu istória nian nu'udar ideia jerál kona-ba moris. The story takes place in a market deskreve de'it fatin, la'ós tema.
hints: Tema la'ós enredu ka fatin, maibé ideia jerál ne'ebé istória hatete kona-ba moris.
Verifika se relasaun entre asaun labarik mane nian no nia rezultadu jeneraliza iha fraze ida, no se la dehan kontráriu ho istória.

e-h3e-lit-5.explanation: Resposta loos mak protagonist (personajen prinsipál). Nia iha sentru istória, iha objetivu no lori eventu. Antagonist mak personajen ne'ebé kontra protagonist, entaun papél kontráriu.
hints: Termu personajen hasai ho papél. Personajen sentrál, ne'ebé kontra no ne'ebé konta istória diferente.
Kompara deskrisaun ‘wants something and drives the action’ iha pergunta ho definisaun termu iha hili ida-idak.

e-h3e-lit-d1.explanation: Padraun ne'ebé sílaba ho énfaze no sílaba la ho énfaze repete regulár mak rhythm (meter). Plot structure mak ordem eventu dezenvolve, la relasiona ho lian.
hints: Pergunta husu kona-ba aspetu lian poema nian. Hasai diferensa se termu literáriu relasiona ho lian no ritmu ka estrutura istória.
Bainhira sílaba stressed no unstressed troka malu, nusá mak sente bainhira ko'alia? Buka termu ba sentimentu ne'e.

e-h3e-debate-1.explanation: Resposta loos mak Bandwagon appeal. Dehan buat ida loos tanba ema barak halo mak sala bandwagon. Hasty generalization mak sala jeneraliza lalais husi kazu uitoan, entaun la hanesan ho pontu prinsipál fraze ne'e.
hints: Ba pergunta sala, husu uluk se baze argumentu mak evidénsia ka buat seluk.
Kompara katak razaun ‘ema hotu halo’ uza atu justifika argumentu ho signifikadu naran sala ida-idak.

e-h3e-debate-2.explanation: Resposta loos mak The park, which opened in May, covers four hectares. Iha de'it faktu ne'ebé bele verifika: tempu loke no área. Best thing the council has ever done mak avaliasaun, entaun subjetivu.
hints: Fraze objetivu iha de'it informasaun ne'ebé ema hotu bele verifika, la iha avaliasaun ka sentimentu.
Buka iha fraze ida-idak liafuan avaliasaun ka sentimentu hanesan wonderful, fool, best.

e-h3e-debate-3.explanation: Resposta loos mak motion. Ne'e deklarasaun ne'ebé sai tópiku debate. Rebuttal mak refutasaun ba argumentu parte seluk, entaun la'ós tópiku rasik.
hints: Hasai diferensa termu debate ho papél sira iha debate.
Kompara saida mak ‘deklarasaun ne'ebé ekipa rua diskute’ hatudu ho termu ba refutasaun, desizaun, rejistu.

e-h3e-debate-4.explanation: Resposta loos mak Statistical evidence. Tanba ne'e númeru husi peskiza ba ema barak. Anecdotal evidence mak esperiénsia pesoál ema ida ka rua, ne'ebé diferente husi inkéritu ne'e.
hints: Tipu evidénsia hasai husi fonte informasaun: ekspertu, esperiénsia pesoál, supozisaun, númeru no seluk.
Haree pista saida mak tamañu amostra (ema 2,000) no persentajen (64%) fó kona-ba natureza evidénsia.

e-h3e-debate-5.explanation: Resposta loos mak persuasive. Depois verbu to be, iha fatin komplementu ne'ebé deskreve sujeitu, adjetivu mak mai. Persuasively mak advérbiu, labele deskreve speech.
hints: Determina uluk klase liafuan fatin mamuk. Ordem liafuan iha oin-kotuk husu klase saida?
Iha estrutura ‘was highly ___’, verifika se fatin ne'e deskreve sujeitu speech, no hili klase liafuan ne'ebé tuir fatin ne'e.

e-h3e-debate-d1.explanation: Tanba rejeita proposta ho baze Lena nia asaun pasadu la'ós konteúdu proposta, ne'e ad hominem (atake pesoál). Straw man mak atake hodi distorse argumentu parte seluk, maibé iha ne'e proposta la distorse.
hints: Ba pergunta sala lójika, haree uluk saida mak kritika. Argumentu rasik ka buat seluk, ne'e hamenus tipu.
Haree se ema ne'ebé koalia diskute konteúdu proposta recycling husi Lena, ka uza faktu seluk kona-ba Lena.

e-h3e-write-1.explanation: Resposta loos mak makes. Make a case for mak kolokasaun ‘argumenta ba’. Holds uza estranhu, no does a case for la'ós espresaun ho signifikadu ne'e.
hints: Parte verbu-naran (kolokasaun) hanoin nu'udar parte, la'ós signifikadu. Hanoin verbu ne'ebé uza ho a case.
Kompara verbu ne'ebé dala barak liga ho case ho signifikadu ‘aprezenta’ argumentu iha relatóriu.

e-h3e-write-2.explanation: Resposta loos mak Organized a school recycling campaign that collected 300 kilograms of paper. Hahú ho verbu no hatudu saida mak halo no rezultadu númeru. Helped with various things ... la hatudu saida mak halo.
hints: CV hatudu rezultadu espesífiku no badak. Evita espresaun la klaru.
Kompara se hili ida-idak koalia kona-ba atividade espesífiku ka hapara iha opiniaun pesoál ka deskrisaun la klaru.

e-h3e-write-3.explanation: Resposta loos mak Although the museum was crowded, we stayed for three hours. Ne'e kontrastu (ema barak maibé hela kleur), entaun Although loos. So we left after a short time kontradiz faktu hela kleur.
hints: Bainhira hamutuk fraze rua, determina uluk relasaun entre faktu rua (kauza, kontrastu, tempu).
Hanoin se faktu ema barak no faktu hela oras tolu iha direksaun espera ka kontráriu.

e-h3e-write-4.explanation: Resposta loos mak The students who joined the club met every Friday. Sujeitu The students iha verbu prinsipál met. Hili ne'ebé hahú ho Because mak klauza subordinada, la iha rezultadu, entaun la kompletu.
hints: Fraze kompletu iha sujeitu no verbu prinsipál no signifikadu kompletu. Labele sai bobar husi klauza relativa, klauza konjunsaun ka grupu -ing.
Buka iha hili ida-idak verbu prinsipál husi klauza prinsipál (verbu ho tempu). Fahe parte depois who ka because.

e-h3e-write-5.explanation: Resposta loos mak an opinion letter to the board. Se objetivu mak konvense, karta opiniaun ne'ebé argumenta ho razaun loos. Diary entry mak nota pesoál, la'ós testu atu konvense komité eskola.
hints: Objetivu testu (konvense, informa, rejistu) no leitór determina tipu testu.
Hanoin ba se, husu saida, no buka forma testu ne'ebé uza ba objetivu ne'e.

e-h3e-write-d1.explanation: Iha faze editing, buka no hadi'a sala gramátika, hakerek no pontuasaun iha testu ne'ebé kompletu ona. Halibur ideia halo iha faze brainstorming (prewriting), entaun diferente husi editing.
hints: Hakerek iha faze sira ho ordem. Hanoin saida mak halo iha faze ida-idak husi planeamentu, rascunho, revizaun, edisaun, no hili deskrisaun ne'ebé tuir faze edisaun.
Editing mak faze bainhira testu besik remata. Hasai diferensa se hili ida-idak mak buat antes hakerek ka hadi'a testu ne'ebé kompletu ona.
